title: ResolutionRequest
description: Request payload for the verana indexer DID Resolver. Selectors with object form (`participations`, `presentations`, `ecosystems`) accept `false` to exclude, `true` for defaults, or an object of fine-grained options. See `### Example resolution request` in the indexer spec.

did.description: DID to resolve. Any DID method supported by the resolver.

atTime.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the point-in-time evaluation. Mutually exclusive with `atBlock`. Defaults to latest block when neither is provided.

atBlock.description: Block height of the point-in-time evaluation. Mutually exclusive with `atTime`. Defaults to latest block when neither is provided.

corporation.description: Include the `corporation` object (the unique Corporation whose `did` equals the resolved DID; carries `id`, `deposit`, slash history, and `cgf`). Per VPR a DID is the `did` of at most one Corporation, so this is a singular object rather than an array. Omit or `false` to exclude. The top-level `corporationId` scalar (which equals `corporation.id` whenever the Corporation exists — by VPR's per-Corporation `did` uniqueness invariant they are necessarily the same) is part of the trust-core fields and is always returned regardless of this selector; this selector only controls whether the full Corporation object (`deposit`, slash history, CGF) is also surfaced inline.

ecsCredentials.description: Include the full ECS credentials with subject claims. Omit or `false` to exclude.

services.description: Include `services[]` — non-LinkedVerifiablePresentation service entries from the DID Document (e.g. DIDComm, MCP, LinkedDomains). Omit or `false` to exclude.

participations.description: Include `participations[]`. `false` to exclude; `true` is sugar for `{}` (defaults: states = [ACTIVE]); object form lets you filter by state.

presentations.description: Include `presentations[]`. Each entry always carries `vtcCredentialIds[]`; the sub-flags additionally surface unresolvable / invalid credential IDs per VP.

ecosystems.description: Include `ecosystems[]`. Sub-flags control whether archived ecosystems (and their archived embedded schemas) are surfaced.

states.description: Filter participations by state. Defaults to ["ACTIVE"] when omitted.

includeArchived.description: When true, also include archived ecosystems in the response.

schemas.description: Embedded schemas selector. `false` (or omit) to suppress; `true` to include with defaults; object form for fine-grained control.

includeArchived.description: When true, also include archived schemas inside each ecosystem.
